Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE skill action concept board for Võ Lâm Hero Defense, not a runtime sprite atlas. Landscape 1536x1024 composition. Input image 1 is the approved Võ Đang character identity; images 2 and 3 are approved runtime palm and straight-sword atlases for exact costume, body proportions, pixel density, weapon and elevated orthographic 3/4 overworld view. Reuse this male Taoist's face, black topknot, white flowing hair ribbon, ivory sleeves, charcoal layered robes, silver embroidery, white sash with yin-yang buckle, black boots and slender silver straight sword. No costume redesign. Detailed crisp chibi wuxia pixel art, hard pixel edges and restrained ivory/charcoal/silver with pale blue accents; no blur or giant glows. Calm disciplined movements. All action illustrations maintain elevated overhead orthographic camera, visible tops of heads/shoulders, never side-view combat or isometric. Main row: four clearly separated full-body key poses, planted feet on one baseline, anticipation -> release -> contact -> recovery; show distinct arm/weapon motion, not repeated idle poses. Lower left: separate VFX stage studies and footprint/direction diagram, thin outlines with open interiors. Lower middle: small gameplay-scale illustration to assess player visibility. Lower RIGHT: ONE square matching ICON CONCEPT in a clearly isolated square tile, with same thin silver corner frame, charcoal backing, generous 15% inner padding, bold ivory/dark silhouette, no letters, numbers, hotkeys or text in the icon. Place icon at exact lower-right quadrant, keep it separate from annotations. Neutral dark slate board background, fine restrained silver dividers, clear professional layout. Board title only ASCII skill ID and small 'CONCEPT - APPROVAL PENDING'; short stage labels in English outside artwork. No numeric damage, ranges, durations, hit counts, cooldowns, or fabricated mechanics. VFX is concept only, no claims of timing. Pose body height will map later to approved 44px logical body height, Quyền80x80 feet40,64, Kiếm96x80 feet48,64; do not enlarge character relative to effect. Formation artwork uses transparent-looking open space (board is opaque).
